queries: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - o.average_figure AS excess, r.figure / o.average_figure AS ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.figure > o.average_figure

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_figures AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), all_regions AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_figures) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - ar.average_figure AS amount_above_average, r.figure / ar.average_figure AS ratio_to_average FROM region_figures AS r CROSS JOIN all_regions AS ar WHERE r.figure > ar.average_figure ORDER BY r.region

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no transactions have a NULL average and do not contribute to their region's average; regions with no defined figure do not contribute to the all-region average.
